items: The finance team prepared a second forecast ____ management could compare two budget scenarios.
'So that' introduces the purpose of preparing a second forecast.
____ the supplier offered a lower price, the purchasing manager chose the vendor with the shorter lead time.
'Although' introduces a contrast between the lower price and the different selection criterion.
The maintenance crew will inspect the elevator again ____ the warning light appears during testing.
'If' introduces the condition that triggers another inspection.
The regional office remained open ____ the headquarters closed early because of the storm.
'Whereas' contrasts the operating status of the two offices.
Please keep the receipt ____ the reimbursement has been deposited into your account.
'Until' marks the endpoint for keeping the receipt.
____ the revised brochure is approved, the marketing team will send it to the printer.
'Once' marks the point after approval when printing can proceed.
The company reserved a larger venue ____ registrations were much higher than expected.
'Because' gives the reason a larger venue was reserved.
The service desk extended its hours ____ customers could receive support after the system migration.
'So that' introduces the purpose of extending service hours.
The contract will renew automatically ____ either party provides written notice by June 30.
'Unless' states the exception that prevents automatic renewal.
____ the first prototype was lightweight, the second model was designed for greater durability.
'While' contrasts the characteristics of the two prototypes.
The analyst checked the figures twice ____ the report contained several unusual variances.
'Since' gives the reason the figures were checked twice.
Employees may work remotely on Friday ____ their supervisors approve the arrangement in advance.
'Provided that' states the condition for remote work.
The warehouse staff will begin unloading ____ the safety inspection has been completed.
'After' correctly places unloading later than the safety inspection.
____ demand rises further this quarter, the factory can add a weekend production shift.
'If' introduces the condition under which a weekend shift can be added.
The client accepted the revised schedule ____ the final delivery date remained unchanged.
'Even though' introduces the unexpected contrast between accepting a revised schedule and an unchanged final date.
The accounting system locks an expense claim ____ the same invoice number is entered twice.
'Whenever' means each time the stated condition occurs.
The branch manager will sign the lease ____ the legal department confirms the final wording.
'As soon as' marks the point immediately after legal confirmation.
____ the shipment arrived earlier than planned, the receiving team was not available until the afternoon.
'Although' introduces the contrast between early arrival and delayed availability.
The supervisor reassigned two technicians ____ the installation site required additional support.
'Because' gives the reason two technicians were reassigned.
The company translated the safety guide into three languages ____ overseas contractors could follow the same procedures.
'So that' introduces the purpose of translating the guide.
The discount remains valid ____ the order is placed before the end of the month.
'As long as' states the condition for the discount to remain valid.
____ the new scanner processes documents faster, it requires more frequent calibration.
'While' introduces a contrast between faster processing and more frequent calibration.
The manager postponed the meeting ____ two key participants were traveling that day.
'Because' gives the reason the meeting was postponed.
The support team will contact the software vendor ____ the same error occurs again.
'If' introduces the condition that triggers contacting the vendor.
The final invoice cannot be issued ____ all approved change orders have been entered into the system.
'Until' marks the prerequisite that must be completed before invoicing.
